coaching.headline: Legion died nine times, Valmont farmed four victims without magical armor, and the enemy took every late objective.

flags.text: Legion died nine times, the most in the game: five outside detected fights, four to Sparrow.
Valmont went 10/2/3 with 38,322 hero damage; zero of four victims built magical armor.
The third Fangtooth, Shaper and Orb Prime fell with no ally dead in the prior 60 seconds.
Zero tanks against Riktor and Aurora; Greystone and Crunch were both divers, leaving no fight starter.

focus.title: Answer the two killers before the objectives
focus.action: In a no-tank draft, the carry farms behind the support until Sparrow's stealth is spent, two more players buy magical armor for Valmont, and all five reach the pit before each late objective.

25.call: Valmont got all three kills, Legion, Dekker and Crunch, in a 0-3 loss right after Dekker destroyed the enemy duo outer tower. Fight Valmont only with anti-heal and magical armor bought.

13.1.call: Won 4-0 over Sparrow, Valmont, Aurora and Riktor, and Crunch took Fangtooth in the same window. The only won fight, and the only allied Fangtooth.

18.6.call: Lost 2-3: Valmont killed Morigesh and Legion, Akeron killed Crunch, and Sparrow destroyed the allied duo outer tower. With no tank, let Aurora and Riktor spend crowd control first.

bbfde750-5ade-46f5-a318-bf0ed248295f: Six deaths against a usual 4.8, three each to Sparrow and Valmont, and hero damage per minute at 520 against a usual 682.
Tainted Scepter into Valmont was the right buy. Physical armor for Sparrow never came.
6107c0a2-fb90-4dbc-969f-11e337c2c621: Standout: first blood on Sparrow, 21 wards against a usual 17.4, seven destroyed, and the enemy duo outer tower. Damn good support work.
Three of four deaths went to Valmont, two on the mid lane. Tainted Charm adds tenacity and anti-heal against Arterial Grip and Exsanguinate.
94600d0d-988c-4883-98d7-fbdfb10b5a74: Took the only allied Fangtooth off the 4-0 fight. Aurora took all three Seedlings and both later Fangtooths.
Objective damage 2,382 against Aurora's 30,813, river camps 18 to 10 the enemy way. When Aurora shows on one side, take the Seedling or camp on the other.
f13c50a0-0139-414f-a43a-9cc8d9174112: Nine deaths against a usual of about seven, the most in the game. That shit is the biggest leak in this loss.
Sparrow finished on 19.1k gold against 15.3k here. Heightened Senses is Sparrow's only escape; hard-engage only after that stealth is spent.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: One death, the fewest on the team, and 11.6 CS per minute against a usual 9. Valmont scored zero kills here.
Zero kills, zero objective damage, and the enemy offlane outer tower stood all game. Turn that farm into tower pressure when the wave gives a safe window.
Draft: a second diver beside Crunch left zero tanks. Steel in the offlane wins 50.6% in the field.

matchup: Valmont went 10/2/3 with three kills here; field record into Valmont is 49.8% over 268 games.
build: Tainted Scepter answered Valmont healing; the field buys Tainted Scepter into Valmont 55% of the time against a usual 24%.
Combustion and Caustica sit outside the 65.6% core of Timewarp, Magnify and Wraith Leggings.
eternal: Vesh fits a magical damage-over-time kit, and Mind Rot adds current-health damage on top.
Lich magical lifesteal stacks with Ritual Of Death healing for longer fights.
augment: Ritual Of Death heals off Curse damage and refunds cooldown on takedowns; three takedowns gave the refund little to work with.
crest: Epoch gives a stasis button but no armor against Sparrow or Valmont.
improvement: Physical armor against Sparrow is the unmet need: three of six deaths went to Sparrow.
Keep Tainted Scepter whenever Valmont is drafted; add Timewarp or Magnify from the 65.6% core next.

matchup: Duo into Sparrow and Riktor read even: first blood on Sparrow, one early duo death each.
Field record into Riktor: 49.3% over 1,304 games.
build: The most played core into Riktor is Crescelia, Timewarp, Dynamo at 54.9%; Megacosm came second here, Timewarp fourth.
Dynamo is the only armor here, and only physical, against a four-magical enemy lineup.
eternal: Vesh with Tithe of Death and Mind Rot is a damage loadout; Tithe of Death haste grows only with takedowns, eight here.
augment: Photon Efficiency rewards landing Photon Disruptor on heroes, a fit for a 25,648 hero damage support.
crest: Reclamation fits the vision job: the ward cap rises from two to three, and Purify cleanses nearby allies.
improvement: Tainted Charm is the unmet need: tenacity against two extra hard-CC abilities and anti-heal against Valmont.
Swap Megacosm for Tainted Charm when Valmont is the enemy threat: less damage, more time alive.

matchup: Aurora took both kills in the first fight, deep in the allied half, and healed 32696 across the game.
Field record into Aurora: 49% over 463 games.
build: Salvation tenacity and Tainted Blade anti-heal met both enemy needs; keep both.
Draconum completes the 61.2% core of Berserker's Axe, Augmentation and Draconum.
eternal: Weald fires true-damage missiles at low-health heroes; Forage adds gold and experience from camps.
augment: The augment lengthens the forward dash: more gap close for a diver in a no-tank draft.
crest: Iceskorn Talons gives allies on the ice sheet power and speed and slows enemies, useful in a draft without a tank.
improvement: No magical armor against a four-magical enemy lineup; Valmont scored two of the six deaths.

matchup: Duo lane read even early; later Sparrow scored four of nine deaths.
Field record into Sparrow: 53.7% over 2,427 games.
build: Infernum and The Perforator sit in the 60.5% core of Malady, Infernum and The Perforator; Malady never came.
Nightfall shield needs takedowns; eight here.
eternal: Knell with Dampening and Fracture shreds armor on repeated hits; Dampening trims only damage from far away.
augment: Press the Advantage adds a Rally Point on each takedown, a weak fit for an eight-takedown, nine-death game.
crest: Witchstalker active cleanses debuffs and adds true damage to the next hit; a defensive keep, not a swap.
improvement: Physical armor is the unmet need against Sparrow, plus Tainted Rounds for anti-heal against Valmont.
Swap Nightfall for Tainted Rounds when Valmont heals: less sustain, more cut healing.

matchup: Akeron dealt 11,913 objective damage and scored the only kill on this offlaner, late in the game.
Field record into Akeron: 49.1% over 587 games.
build: Overlord and Rapture match the 65.8% core of Overlord, Rapture and Forticus; Forticus never came.
Tainted Bastion and Saphir's Mantle held the only magical armor on the team; Tainted Bastion also cuts Valmont healing.
eternal: Krix with Voracity and Cannibalism stacks health; Cannibalism grows with takedowns, two here.
augment: Tainted Oath puts Blight on Sacred Oath hits: anti-heal against Valmont and Akeron healing.
crest: Saphir's Mantle adds both armors and a health-growing active, a solid front line fit.
improvement: Salvation is the unmet need: tenacity against two extra enemy hard-CC abilities.
Swap Fire Blossom for Salvation against Riktor and Aurora crowd control: less burn, more time acting.

threats: Chain-CC risk (4 hard-CC abilities, ~3.5s of lockdown): Riktor Riplash (pull), Riktor Shock Therapy (silence 0.8s), Riktor Skewer (suppress 1.25s), Akeron Web Lash (root 1s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Enemy is 4/5 magical — one magic-resist item goes a long way.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Crunch Right Crunch (knockup 1.25s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Mark a hero, land Hive to slow and stack Pestilence, run through them with Swarm, then cast Curse on the Marked target to cash the Mark in.
ourKits.winCondition: Keep Pestilence stacked on a squishy with Hive and Swarm, then finish them with Curse while Mark and Swarm heal her through the trade.
ourKits.passive: Pestilence: her damaging abilities stack a max-health magical damage over time, and Fetid Dagger hits refresh it.
ourKits.playWith: Lane partners or junglers with setup that hold her Marked target in place for Curse.
ourKits.playAgainst: Dodge Hive, since its slow sets up everything else, and trade when Swarm is down because it is her damage reduction, speed and main heal. Anti-heal cuts the healing from Mark and Swarm.

ourKits.combo: Containment Fence traps a target, Stasis Bomb stuns from range, Ion Strike blasts to stun the center and slow the edge, and Photon Disruptor slows
ourKits.winCondition: trap a target in the fence and chain stuns so the team collapses
ourKits.passive: jumping mid-air fires Rocket Boots upward and speeds nearby allies; abilities cut its cooldown
ourKits.playWith: burst that converts her stun and fence into a kill
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Stasis Bomb, whose stun gets longer the farther it travels; step out of the Ion Strike center during its delay; stay out of the fence ring or flank around it; tenacity shortens her stuns

ourKits.combo: Forward Crunch dashes in to stun, Left Crunch and Right Crunch build Turbo, then the Turbo Crunch version (long push dash, true-damage double swipe, or knockup uppercut) lands, with Re-Crunch repeating the last ability
ourKits.winCondition: chain abilities into Turbo Crunch empowered hits and heal through Re-Crunch's passive
ourKits.passive: each ability empowers his next basic attack and cuts his cooldowns; two ability casts activate Turbo Crunch, enhancing his next basic ability
ourKits.playWith: engage and peel-stripping teammates so he can reach the backline
ourKits.playAgainst: fight after Forward Crunch is used, since it is his long-cooldown gap closer; respect his second ability cast because the next one is Turbo-enhanced; anti-heal blunts Re-Crunch healing and armor helps against his physical damage

ourKits.combo: Saturation Charge mines to slow, Frag Order to launch enemies, Orbital Sanction to track them, Rally Point to knock back divers and heal allies.
ourKits.winCondition: Hold an area with Orbital Sanction and mines while Rally Point keeps his team healthy and his rifle on infinite ammo.
ourKits.passive: Ballistic Calibration turns bonus attack speed into ability haste and unlocks ability upgrades at item stat thresholds.
ourKits.playWith: Frontliners who fight inside Rally Point's heal and hold enemies in the Orbital beam.
ourKits.playAgainst: Stun him while he cooks Frag Order to make him drop it. Bait Rally Point's knockback before engaging, trade when he reloads, and buy anti-heal against Rally Point's heal and armor against his physical damage.

ourKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap in, Make Way to shred armor, Sacred Oath empowered cleave to slow, then Stone Forged Soul to heal in Stasis and crash down.
ourKits.winCondition: Stay in the middle of fights and use Stone Forged Soul's missing-health heal to reset, while Make Way shreds armor for the team.
ourKits.passive: Stoicism deflects the next basic attack on a cooldown and grants health regen and armor that grow as he loses health.
ourKits.playWith: Damage dealers who can follow his leap and benefit from Make Way's armor shred.
ourKits.playAgainst: Do not burst into Stone Forged Soul's Stasis; step away from the slow and the crash, then re-engage. Open with an ability since Stoicism deflects a basic, and buy anti-heal to cut the ult heal.

enemyKits.combo: Riplash to pull a hero in, Shock Therapy to break their shield and silence, Electrocute aura for damage and a shield, then Skewer to suppress everyone in front of him.
enemyKits.winCondition: Land Riplash and chain silence and suppress so the target cannot fight back while their cooldowns stay frozen.
enemyKits.passive: Suspended Sentence: while his abilities immobilize or silence a hero, their cooldowns stop ticking.
enemyKits.playWith: Burst that deletes his pulled or suppressed target.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Stay behind minions or spaced so Riplash cannot reach you, and fight while it is on cooldown. Tenacity shortens the chain, which also shortens the cooldown freeze.

enemyKits.combo: Web Lash roots a hero or leaps from terrain to knock up and stun, Crushing Maw bites for damage and healing, Hellfire's Demon Eye stacks slows, then Consume pulls enemies into his maw to bite and execute
enemyKits.winCondition: stack Hunger to become Awakened, then win extended fights with Awakened damage reduction, armor shred and Consume executes
enemyKits.passive: dealing and taking damage builds Hunger for more healing; at max Hunger he is Awakened with damage reduction and empowered basic abilities
enemyKits.playWith: teammates with follow-up damage on his Web Lash root who can push targets into Consume execute range
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Web Lash and watch for him lashing to walls before the leap stun; stay out of the Consume cone while he is slowed pulling, and avoid long trades once he is Awakened; buy anti-heal for his Crushing Maw and Consume healing

enemyKits.combo: Arterial Grip to ground and slow → Bloodbound for attack speed → basics to trigger Hemophagia → Exsanguinate bats to heal
enemyKits.winCondition: bind a target with Arterial Grip and out-sustain them with Hemophagia strikes and Exsanguinate's healing
enemyKits.passive: Hemophagia makes Lilith strike targets hit by his basics or Bloodbound, and takedowns restore mana
enemyKits.playWith: frontliners who keep enemies in range so his bind and bats keep landing
enemyKits.playAgainst: Arterial Grip breaks if you CC him, break line of sight, or get far enough away; buy anti-heal against Exsanguinate and magical armor

enemyKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses for attack speed → Hail of Arrows slow → Inner Fire barrage
enemyKits.winCondition: stack Relentless with basics and abilities to add max-health damage and melt the frontline in long fights
enemyKits.passive: Relentless stacks on hit and makes her basics deal bonus max-health damage
enemyKits.playWith: peel and a frontline, since her only escape is a short stealth
enemyKits.playAgainst: Heightened Senses is her only escape, a brief stealth with speed and no dash, so hard-engage her after it is used; Piercing Shot passes through terrain, so do not hide behind walls at low health

enemyKits.combo: Glacial Charge dashes in, Boreal Sweep slows, Hoarfrost roots enemies that touch the ring, then Cryoseism slows and stuns a target before it explodes
enemyKits.winCondition: chain slow, root and stun to lock fights down while her Frost Storm grinds max-health damage
enemyKits.passive: jumping mid-air leaps her and leaves a Replica that draws tower aggro; hitting a Hero or Monster 4 times summons a Frost Storm
enemyKits.playWith: burst damage that turns her long CC chain into kills
enemyKits.playAgainst: do not walk into the Hoarfrost ring while it persists; Cryoseism slows before it stuns, so cleanse or tenacity help, and spread so the explosion does not chain; she is weak once Glacial Charge is down

fedBy: Hemophagia (passive): When Valmont deals damage to an Enemy with Crimson Sigil or Bloodbound causes Lilith to strike them, dealing 12/20/28/36/44/23/31/39/47 (Based on Bloodbound Level) (+15%) magical damage. The more attack speed Valmont has, the shorter the delay between strikes is. On Enemy Takedown their soul is consumed by Lilith and you restore 3/3/4/4/5/5/6/7/8/10/12/15/18/21/24/27/30/33-41 Mana (Based on Hero Level). Consuming the soul of an Enemy Hero restores 35% Maximum Mana additionally.
lines: Lead story: Hard to kill. Died 2 times in 34 minutes, fewer deaths than about 89% of Valmont mid players this patch. The build added health and armor and healing off damage.
Exsanguinate at top rank: 5s base, about 3.6s by the end (28% shorter) from 40 ability haste: Entropy 15, Azure Core 10, Lifebinder 15.
13 takedowns (10 kills, 3 assists) fed: Hemophagia (passive).
Their build heals off damage: anti-heal (the Tainted items) cuts it.
Valmont dealt 38,322 hero damage, 30% of their team's, with +410 magical power from items.
Entropy (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 3 (+3.5%) additional Damage. Each Ability can only trigger this effect once every 0.2s, per Target.
Dreambinder (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Slows by 30% for 1s. Reduced to 20% for DoT Abilities.
Sustain: 12% magical lifesteal; Azure Core: On going below 40% Health: Gain a 100 (+12%) Shield for 5s.; 5,173 healing recorded.
Toughness: +325 health; took 27,316 damage, mitigated 15,316, died 2 times.
Stack (Every ability hit set off): 2 effects on one trigger: Entropy, Dreambinder. Valmont has 4 damaging abilities, and 40 ability haste brought them back 29% sooner: more casts, more triggers.
Stack (Kept alive in fights): 2 effects on one trigger: Azure Core, Lifebinder. Together they made staying in a long fight cheaper: more armor, shields or healing the longer it went.
Countered? 0 of the 4 players Valmont killed built magical armor. We killed Valmont 2 times.
Copy it? Too few Valmont midlane games with this Eternal or core this patch to say whether it wins elsewhere.

card.lesson: Exsanguinate came back about every 4s instead of 5s by the end (28% shorter). Count it, and take fights while it is down.

lines: Sparrow dealt 26,619 hero damage, 21% of their team's, with +265 physical power from items.

Penetration: Vanquisher 12, Demolisher ignores 25%; against Legion (level 17 estimated: about 110 physical armor, 71 after penetration) and Morigesh (level 17 estimated: about 101 physical armor, 63 after penetration) that is about 23% and 23% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Sky Splitter (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Deal 5% of Target's Current Health as Damage On-Hit. Reduced to 3.5% for Ranged Heroes. Minimum of 12 Damage.
Imperator (item): Critical Strikes deal 30% more damage.
Sustain: 7% lifesteal; Equinox: On going below 40% Health: Gain a 350-750 Shield for 4s. Shield size increases with Level.; 3,425 healing recorded.
Toughness: +20% tenacity; took 28,158 damage, mitigated 12,093, died 4 times.

Lesson: Sparrow's penetration cut through: Legion took about 23% more physical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 17 (estimated) their armor was about 110, about 71 after 12 flat + 25% penetration).
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 3 effects on one trigger: Dust Devil, Sky Splitter, Demolisher.
Stack (Finishing damage on low-health targets): 2 effects on one trigger: Vanquisher, Equinox. Once a fight started going their way, these finished it.
Stack (Kept alive in fights): 2 effects on one trigger: Equinox, Demolisher. Together they made staying in a long fight cheaper: more armor, shields or healing the longer it went.
Countered? 1 of the 4 players Sparrow killed built physical armor (Dekker). Anti-heal on Morigesh, Crunch, Greystone. We killed Sparrow 4 times.
Copy it? Too few Sparrow carry games with this Eternal or core this patch to say whether it wins elsewhere.

bullets: Sanguine Banquet healed Valmont on all damage dealt, more with bonus mana; Epoch and Entropy raised Valmont's max mana, and kills raised max mana further.
Vesh turned Rupture, Bloodbound and Exsanguinate hero hits into extra damage over time, Mind Rot added current-health damage, and Lich stacked Valmont's magical lifesteal with Lifebinder.
Exsanguinate's bats restored 8x health to Valmont on hero hits, and 40 ability haste from Entropy, Azure Core and Lifebinder made Exsanguinate's cooldown 28% shorter.
Sun Shards bounced Sparrow's basic attacks to extra enemies for reduced damage, carrying weaker copies of on-hit effects like Sky Splitter's current-health hit.
Exarch gave Sparrow attack speed and on-hit damage while healed or shielded; Revelation sped up basic abilities per cast; Delayed Fate delayed part of ability damage taken.
Heightened Senses and Eviscerator's active both raised Sparrow's attack speed, so more basic attacks triggered Dust Devil and Sky Splitter and ignored armor through Demolisher.
Stasis Bomb's stun and Ion Strike's center stun set off Dynamo, so the target took 8% more damage, while Megacosm turned each ability hit into a burn.
Vesh added damage over time to Stasis Bomb and Photon Disruptor hero hits, Mind Rot added current-health damage, Tithe of Death gave Dekker mana and haste per takedown.
Crescelia empowered Dekker's next basic attack after ability casts, Timewarp kept cutting non-ultimate cooldowns for more casts, and Reclamation could cleanse Dekker and nearby allies.
Skewer's suppress set off Vortex Stone, shielding Riktor and cutting basic ability cooldowns; Forticus and Frosted Lure added shields, and Transference returned 50% of leftover shields as health.
Idrisil raised Riktor's armors while healthy and, when low, shielded Riktor based on armor from Forticus and Frosted Lure; Glacier added magical armor, Mending restored Riktor's missing health.
Wanton Warden healed back part of the damage Riktor took, Electrocute shielded Riktor while the aura burned nearby enemies, and Sanctification shielded Riktor and nearby allies with tenacity.

Legion died 9 times, 4 to Sparrow, and ended on 15,258 gold against Sparrow's 19,095.

focus.action: Draft a tank, buy magical armor against Valmont, wait out Riktor Skewer and Aurora Cryoseism before committing, and group on Shaper and Orb Prime before each spawn.

Next game, hold both stuns until Aurora spends Hoarfrost and Cryoseism, then open the pick this draft needs.
